Interface PostgresChangeEventMetadata

All Superinterfaces:
ChangeEventMetadata
public sealed interface PostgresChangeEventMetadata extends ChangeEventMetadata
PostgreSQL notification metadata identifying the affected table and row keys.

Instances are supplied by the PostgreSQL notification provider.

Keys use exact database column names, including case, rather than Java property names. Values are the textual representation of PostgreSQL JSON scalar values, without surrounding JSON quotes. In particular, numeric identifiers retain their precision. Both maps are immutable and support composite keys. Inserts have no old keys, deletes have no new keys, and updates retain both, including when a primary key changes. Table invalidations have neither.

Since:
5.3.0
